Our model contains 224.88M parameters and requires 8.7OG FLOPs for a single forward pass, with an average inference time of $1 . 5 3 \mathrm { m s }$ per sample on an NVIDIA 3090 GPU. Although our model has a comparatively large parameter count, each of the two paths can operate independently.

Figure 7 illustrates the effect of component depth on model's performance. For DGLQA,a depth of 3 provides the best trade-off, yielding the highest correlation (O.8O3) while maintaining a robust Acc5of $5 4 . 8 1 \%$ . For GPath CA,a depth of 2 yields the optimal results across both datasets,with deeper settings showing diminishing returns. GPath depth 2 is critical for MOSI, whereas MOSEI is less sensitive to this parameter.
